question.text: A tayberry is a cross between which two fruits?

results.hint: Both parent fruits are familiar bramble berries in the genus Rubus.
results.explanation: A tayberry combines blackberry and raspberry; it was developed in Scotland and named for the River Tay.

question.text: The pasta gemelli has what meaning in Italian?

question.text: In which country would you find the UNESCO World Heritage site of The Bam Citadel?

question.text: Which English rock band released the studio album 'Animals'?

question.text: What is the capital city of Nepal?

question.text: In which country was Greenpeace founded in 1971?

question.text: Which country won the 1962 FIFA World Cup, hosted in Chile?

question.text: What Is The Alloy Pewter Made From

results.hint: This traditional alloy was once common in tankards and serving dishes.
results.explanation: Traditional pewter was made mainly from lead and tin. Modern pewter is generally lead-free and may include antimony and copper instead.

question.text: Which of the following is the oldest city in the United States?

question.text: Which bone is NOT part of the human skull?

results.hint: The bones in this group make up the wrist.
results.explanation: Carpal bones form the wrist; the occipital and temporal bones are parts of the cranium, while the maxilla forms the upper jaw.

question.text: Who Was The 2nd Wife Of Henry VIII?

results.hint: She was the mother of Elizabeth I, who later became queen of England.
results.explanation: Anne Boleyn was the mother of Elizabeth I and was executed in 1536, when Elizabeth was still a child.
